public_rationale: The June evaluation confirms that safety and unnecessary refusal must be assessed together and that the appropriate balance depends on the application. Earlier classifier research supplies material evidence of improvement. Neither establishes that all June guardrails were ineffective, nor supplies a sufficiently matched current counterexample. limitations: The independent June evaluation was produced in partnership with NVIDIA, while stating that analysis was independent.
Classifier benchmarks do not establish the safety of an entire deployed system.
The strongest cited improvement results are historical and company-reported.
